name: Merciless Killer (Combat)
body:
You are quick to bring death to your helpless enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Sneak attack +5d6

Benefit: You only need to take a standard action to deliver a coup de grace, and when you do, you deal 1 extra point of damage per die of sneak attack you possess.

Normal: Delivering a coup de grace takes a full-round action.
